_comment: US-market fitment research decisions (2026-11-18). Read by scripts/audit-toyota-catalog.mjs: EXCLUDE and HOLD listings are hidden from the storefront, sitemap and feeds (group C) and kept in the catalog; KEEP/UPDATE listings follow the normal rules. HOLD means a US Toyota version of the product exists but this listing's unit is a different, vehicle-specific SKU -- publish only after the supplier confirms it can supply the US-market SKU, at a confirmed price, with matching photos. Evidence is internal and never shown to customers.

decisions.evidence: Vivid Racing: T-D6 19x9.5 5x112 +34/+35, 19x11 5x112 +40, CB 66.6; Speed Industry: T-D6 19in A90 MKV Supra GR full set (19x9.5 +35 front, 19x11 +40 rear); UroTuning: Titan 7 T-D6 19in 5x112 (TD601995035511266MB); BimmerWorld: T-D6 set sized for GR Supra / G29, no spacers required.

Vivid Racing: T-S5 19x11 5x112 +40, CB 66.5; Speed Industry: T-S5 19in A90 MKV Supra GR front and rear fitment (19x11 +40 rear); Wheelfront and ThreePiece GR Supra guide: 19x9.5 +34 front / 19x11 +40 rear; AMS Performance T-S5 GR Supra page: clears OEM brakes; BimmerWorld: set for G29 / Supra.

AMS Performance T-S5 GR Supra: 20x9.5 +37 front, 20x11 +43 rear, 5x112, CB 66.6; Wheelfront GR Supra build on 20x9.5 +37 / 20x11 +43 T-S5 with 265/30R20 and 295/30R20; BimmerWorld 20-inch set for G29 / Supra, front 20x9.5 ET37, no spacers.
decisions.confidence: high (rear offset +43 per AMS and Wheelfront)

decisions.application: Candidate: 2016-2023 Tacoma (short and long bed), 2024+ Tacoma long bed, 2007-2021 and 2022+ Tundra 5.5/6.5 ft bed -- each a separate vehicle-specific SKU
decisions.evidence: Alu-Cab lists the Canopy Camper for Tundra 2007-2021 and 2022+ (5.5 and 6.5 bed) and Tacoma Gen 4 long bed; US dealers list it for 2016+ Tacoma. This listing is the LandCruiser 79/300 unit and is priced at $4,856.77 while US dealers list the Tacoma Canopy Camper from about $11,828, so the listing cannot be relabeled as the US product without supplier confirmation of SKU and price.
decisions.confidence: high that a US Toyota version exists; listing unit unconfirmed

decisions.application: Candidate: 2016-2023 Tacoma, 2024+ Tacoma, Tundra -- separate vehicle-specific SKUs
decisions.evidence: US dealers list the RSI SmartCap EVOd Defender for 2024+ Tacoma and EVO-series caps for 2016-2023 Tacoma and 2022+ Tundra. This listing is the LandCruiser 70/300 unit; the Tacoma and Tundra caps are different SKUs and sizes.
decisions.confidence: high that a US Toyota version exists; listing unit unconfirmed

decisions.application: Candidate: 2022+ Toyota Tundra (HSP part TUN4RS3.5) -- a retractable bed cover, not a canopy
decisions.evidence: Australian retailers list an HSP Roll R Cover Series 3.5 for the Toyota Tundra (TUN4RS3.5). No US dealer or US-market fitment found. This listing is the Hilux unit.

decisions.application: Candidate: 2005-2015 and 2016-2023 Tacoma (5 and 6 ft bed) -- only as a dealer-installed Norweld tray + canopy system
decisions.evidence: Main Line Overland (exclusive US Norweld dealer) offers Norweld tray and canopy systems for 2nd Gen and 2016+ Tacoma from $6,699 installed; Norweld publishes a USA price list. The US product replaces the bed with a tray; this listing is a LandCruiser 79 tray canopy, not a bed-mounted unit.

decisions.application: None found for a US-market Toyota
decisions.evidence: ARB's US canopy for Toyota is the Ascent (2024+ Tacoma 5 ft bed, AC19C), a different product. No US dealer lists the Classic canopy for Tacoma or Tundra. Listing fitment: Hilux dual cab.

decisions.application: None found for a US-market Toyota
decisions.evidence: No US listing of an ARB Pinnacle canopy; ARB USA sells only the Ascent for Tacoma. Listing fitment 'LandCruiser 300 dual cab' describes a body style that does not exist (the 300 Series is a wagon).

decisions.application: None found for a US-market Toyota
decisions.evidence: EGR's US Tacoma range is visors, hood guards, cab spoilers and a tonneau cover; no canopy. Listing fitment: Hilux N80 dual cab.

decisions.evidence: Carryboy 560 canopies are listed only for Hilux and other non-US pickups, by UK/EU distributors. No US dealer or Tacoma/Tundra version found.

decisions.evidence: No US dealer or Tacoma/Tundra version found. Listing fitment: Hilux dual cab.

decisions.evidence: No US dealer or Tacoma/Tundra version found. Listing fitment: LandCruiser 79 / Hilux.

decisions.evidence: TJM's canopy range covers Hilux, Ranger, D-Max and others, not Tacoma or Tundra; TJM's US Tacoma products are awnings and rooftop tents. Listing fitment 'LandCruiser 300 / Prado' names two SUVs.
